visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde-streaked braided hair, wearing a grey beanie and a grey tank top with graphic text, poses in a white room with padded walls covered in black graffiti. She holds a sleek white smartphone with three distinct circular lenses. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her accessories like a beaded necklace and silver rings. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room with a glass-brick wall and a metallic chair. The woman wears a red baseball cap and a dark denim vest over a maroon crop top. She poses while holding the white phone, smiling at the camera. (3) A screen recording of the smartphone interface shows a photo of the woman on the chair. A hand interacts with the screen, selecting the 'AI Image Assistant' and 'AI Inspiration Composition' features. A golden grid appears over the image, and various cropping options are shown at the bottom. (4) The woman is now outdoors under a covered walkway with red brick pillars. She wears a black crochet beanie and a red top with a white lace overlay. She takes a selfie using the phone's front camera. The screen shows the 'Portrait' mode interface with the aperture slider adjusted to f1.4 for a shallow depth of field. (5) The setting moves to a dark room with graffiti. The woman, now wearing headphones, uses the phone's flash to take a night portrait. The camera shows the bright flash illuminating her face against the dark background. (6) A final sequence displays various selfies of the woman with vintage-style 'CCD' filters applied. The video ends with a close-up of the white OPPO Reno14 Pro phone body and the woman posing with it in the denim outfit.
